comments.author: @TheLivingGreeceProject
comments.text: Italy is another country that rewards getting away from the famous stops. Give us a small village, a local café and nowhere in particular we need to be next, and we’re happy. Beautiful journey through this side of Italy.

replies.author: @TraceTheGlobe
replies.text: We couldn’t agree more! ❤ Some of Italy’s most unforgettable moments are found far from the famous landmarks — in quiet villages, local cafés, and the simple rhythm of everyday life. We’re so glad you enjoyed discovering this side of Italy with us. 🇮🇹✨
